name: selfcheck
notes: Small recorded tasks with programmatic checks: the agent's own regression set. Run: uv run python -m daedalus --state-dir <dir> bench bench/selfcheck.json --preset <preset>

tasks.prompt: Create a file named hello.txt in the workspace containing exactly the line: hello, daedalus
The script calc.py has a bug: `python3 calc.py 3 4` must print 7 but prints 34. Fix it without changing the interface.
Count how many lines in data/log.txt contain the word ERROR (case-sensitive) and write only that number into count.txt.

files.data/log.txt:
INFO start
ERROR disk
WARN slow
ERROR net
error lowercase
ERROR auth

tasks.prompt: Read people.json (a list of {name, age}) and write adults.json containing only the names (a JSON list of strings) of people aged 18 or older, in the original order.
Run `python3 -m pytest -q` in the workspace. One test fails; fix the code in slugify.py (not the test) so the whole suite passes.
The file words.txt has one word per line. Write the five most frequent words, one per line, most frequent first, into top.txt.

files.words.txt:
a
b
a
c
b
a
d
e
f
b
a
c

tasks.check: test "$(head -1 top.txt)" = a && test "$(sed -n 2p top.txt)" = b && test $(wc -l < top.txt) -eq 5

tasks.prompt: Create a Python module fib.py with a function fib(n) returning the n-th Fibonacci number (fib(0)=0, fib(1)=1), iterative, with a docstring. Then create a file DONE with the single word ok.
tasks.check: test "$(cat DONE)" = ok && python3 -c "from fib import fib; assert fib(10) == 55 and fib(0) == 0"

tasks.prompt: Every file under src/ prints a greeting with the wrong name 'Wrold'. Fix the typo to 'World' in all of them.
tasks.check: ! grep -r Wrold src && grep -rq World src/sub/c.py
